summary: This PR fixes previous security vulnerabilities by switching to parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection and loading credentials from environment variables.

findings.title: Consider adding input validation for search query length
findings.explanation: While parameterized queries effectively prevent SQL injection, adding length and character restrictions on user input helps protect database query execution and caching resources.
findings.suggested_fix:
if len(query) > 100:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Query too long')
